job.job_description:
Our BCG X teams own the full AI value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI
Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions

As a Lead/Principal AI Software Engineer you'll be part of our rapidly growing engineering team and help to build the next generation of AI solutions
you'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like AI led business transformation, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions
Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X
We are looking for talented individuals with a passion for software development, large-scale Gen AI/ Agentic AI programs and transforming organizations into AI led innovative companies
Successful candidates possess the following:
Apply Gen AI/ Agentic AI capabilities to transform businesses/ SDLC
Experienced in developing solutions related to Conversational AI or Agentic process automation or Agentic software development lifecycle
Actively involved in every part of the life cycle including product design, scoping, solution design, development, deployment and adoption
Experienced at guiding non-technical teams and consultants in and best practices for robust Agentic AI platforms development
Optimize for accuracy, latency and costs of deploying Agentic AI solutions
Motivated by a fast-paced, service-oriented environment and interacting directly with clients on new features for future product releases
Enjoy collaborating in teams to share AI platforms design and solution ideas
A natural problem-solver and intellectually curious across a breadth of industries and topics
What you'll Bring
Deep Experience in software development and working with global and remote agile squads
Proficient in implementing AI platforms like LangGraph, AWS Bedrock, GCP Geminin Enterprise, Azure AI Foundry, Crew AI etc
Optimize and enhance computational efficiency of algorithms/ LLMs and AI platforms
Familiarity with the storage, manipulation, and management of relational, non-relational and streaming data structures
Understanding of parallel computing
Experience working on Large Language Models (LLMs), AWS, Azure, or Google cloud infrastructure
Apply software development practices and standards to develop robust and maintainable software
Comfortable in a client-facing role, manage engagements, client relationships, provide thought leadership to teams
Experienced at guiding non-technical teams and consultants in and best practices for robust software development
Motivated by a fast-paced, service-oriented environment and interacting directly with clients on new features for future product releases
A natural problem-solver and intellectually curious across a breadth of industries and topics
Have strong project management skills and can act as interface between business & tech for our clients
Nice To Have
Build generative AI tool
Full stack development: GraphQL, React, JavaScript, TypeScript
DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform
Data: SQL, Spark, Hadoop
Data Science and machine learning (Pandas, Scikit learn)
Ability to travel based on client and business needs
